remarks: Welcome to 118 Grove St, Unit 1-an exceptional townhome offering style and comfort in the heart of Downtown Stamford. Step into the bright living room featuring a cozy fireplace, perfect for relaxing evenings. The open layout leads to a charming outdoor patio, ideal for grilling and entertaining. The kitchen is well-appointed with stainless steel appliances and ample storage. Each spacious bedroom includes its own private bathroom and generous closet space. The master bathroom stands out with its high ceilings and abundant natural light, creating an inviting and serene space. A finished basement-one of the few in the complex-adds extra versatility for a home office, gym, or recreation room. Plus, enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry. With its prime location, modern features, and thoughtful details, this townhome is a must-see. Schedule your tour today!
